svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Population reported as experiencing homelessness at a
single point in time per 100,000 people. The data is
collected by counting the people living on the street or
staying in shelters on one night of the year. Countries
use different definitions and data collection methods
and are harmonized to the extent possible.

g.text: Living in the streets or public spaces
Staying in temporary accommodation or shelters

tspan.tspan: Data for the United Kingdom only considers England

text.tspan: and is expressed in households. Where data for 2023 is
unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2017
